assessment: This important study provides convincing evidence that a third SARS-CoV-2 vaccination elicits substantial increases in spike antibody responses, decreasing variability in titers observed after first and second doses, and also decreasing differences between groups at low and high-risk of low antibody responses. High antibody titers are subsequently associated with a lower incidence of infection. This paper is strong methodologically and will be of interest to clinicians and public health officials.
